description: Find Oregon DMV field offices with street address, city, ZIP, phone number, latitude and longitude, and the ODOT region each belongs to. Covers all 60 DMV offices in Oregon, so it answers "DMV office in Eugene", "address and phone for the Bend DMV", "Oregon DMV offices near the coast", or "which DMV offices are in the Portland area". Each office also carries whether it is appointment-only and a link to its ODOT page. For the live queue length at these same offices use or_dmv_wait_times.

city.description: City name, matched as a substring, e.g. "Portland", "Salem".

region.description: ODOT region substring. One of Central Oregon, Eastern Oregon, Portland Area, Southern Oregon, The Coast, Willamette Valley.

zip.description: Five-digit ZIP code, e.g. "97321". A prefix such as "973" also matches.

name: or_dmv_offices
title: Or Dmv Offices
